exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI:

  1) Ega BIRLIKmi yoki KO'PLIKmi?
       I, he, she, it, birlik ot → was / wasn't
       you, we, they, ko'plik ot → were / weren't

  2) TASDIQmi yoki INKORmi?
       'any' bo'lsa — deyarli DOIM inkor
       'No, ...' javobi — inkor
       'but' oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi qo'yadi

DIQQAT — 'THERE WAS' va 'THERE WERE':
  'there' ga emas, KEYINGI OTGA qaraladi:
     Was there A SUPERMARKET?   (birlik)
     Were there ANY CINEMAS?    (ko'plik)

DIQQAT — 'MY FRIENDS AND I':
  Bu birikma KO'PLIK ('we' bilan bir xil) → WERE.
  Ingliz tilida 'I' oxirida turadi (odob qoidasi):
     My friends and I  ✓
     I and my friends  ✗

items.whyUz:
'your brother' BIRLIK → WAS.
'yesterday' = kecha → o'tgan zamon.

items.textEn: 2  There ............ any cinemas here a hundred years ago.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'cinemas' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.
'a hundred years ago' = yuz yil oldin.

items.textEn: 3  My friends and I ............ at a party last night.
items.whyUz:
'My friends and I' — KO'PLIK ('we' bilan bir xil) → WERE.
DIQQAT: 'I' oxirida turadi — odob qoidasi.

items.textEn: 4  ............ there a supermarket on this street ten years ago?
items.whyUz:
'a supermarket' BIRLIK → WAS.
So'roq gapda 'Was there ...?' — boshda.
'on this street' = bu ko'chada.

'you' → DOIM WERE (birlik ma'noda ham).
'at work' = ishda.

'I' → WASN'T.
DIQQAT: savolda WERE, javobda WASN'T — ega o'zgardi.

items.textEn: 6  "............ there any hotels on the island in those days?"  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'hotels' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'in those days' = o'sha kunlarda (Coursebook 64-betdan).

Savol 'Were there ...?' → javob 'No, there WEREN'T.'
Savoldagi shakl javobda takrorlanadi.

items.hintUz: Keyingi gapga qarang — u qayerda edi?
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: keyingi gapda 'He ... at the theatre' deyilgan —
demak UYDA EMAS edi → INKOR.
'James' BIRLIK → WASN'T.

'He' BIRLIK → WAS.
'at the theatre' = teatrda.
Ikki gap birga: uyda emasdi, teatrda edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in am/'m not, is/isn't, are/aren't, was/wasn't, were/weren't.
exercises.instructionUz: am/'m not, is/isn't, are/aren't, was/wasn't, were/weren't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ HOZIRGI va O'TGAN ZAMONNI ARALASHTIRADI.

JADVAL:
            HOZIRGI          O'TGAN
  I          am / 'm not      was / wasn't
  he/she/it  is / isn't       was / wasn't
  you/we/they are / aren't    were / weren't

ZAMON BELGILARI:
  HOZIRGI: now, today, at the moment,
           vaqt belgisi umuman yo'q (doimiy fakt)
  O'TGAN:  last night, yesterday, twenty years ago,
           in those days

DIQQAT — MILLAT va KELIB CHIQISh:
  'Are you from Italy?' — DOIMIY fakt → HOZIRGI zamon.
  Odamning qayerdanligi o'zgarmaydi.

DIQQAT — "I'M NOT":
  'I am not' ning qisqa shakli — 'I'M NOT'.
  'I amn't' shakli ingliz tilida YO'Q.

items.whyUz:
'last night' → O'TGAN zamon.
'you' → WERE.

items.textEn: 1  B: I ............ at the new restaurant.
items.whyUz:
'I' → WAS.
Suhbat kecha haqida davom etyapti.

'the food' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot, birlik kabi → WAS.
Suhbat hali ham kechagi restoran haqida.
'Was ...?' savoliga → 'No, it WASN'T.'

'It' → WAS.
'awful' = dahshatli, juda yomon.
Oldingi band bilan mos: yaxshi emasdi — dahshatli edi.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ your parents at home now?
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamonga o'tildi.
'your parents' KO'PLIK → ARE.

items.hintUz: Qisqa INKOR javob, hozirgi zamon, ko'plik
items.whyUz: 'Are ...?' savoliga → 'No, they AREN'T.'

'They' → ARE.
'on holiday' = ta'tilda (predlog ON).

items.textEn: 1  B: My little brother ............ with them.
items.whyUz:
'My little brother' BIRLIK → IS.
'little' bu yerda = kichik (yosh).
'with them' = ular bilan.

items.textEn: 2  A: ............ there any department stores in your town twenty years ago?
items.whyUz:
'department stores' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'twenty years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'Were there ...?' → 'No, there WEREN'T.'

items.textEn: 2  ... but there ............ some great ones today.
items.whyUz:
'today' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'some great ones' KO'PLIK → ARE.
'ones' = 'department stores' o'rniga turibdi.
'some' — tasdiq gapda ('any' emas).

items.textEn: 2  The one I like ............ in Park Street.
items.whyUz:
'The one' BIRLIK → IS.
Oldingi band bilan solishtiring: 'ones' ko'plik edi → are.
'Park Street' — 36-betdagi xaritadagi ko'cha.

Odamning qayerdanligi — DOIMIY fakt → HOZIRGI zamon.
'you' → ARE.

'Are you ...?' savoliga 'I' bilan javob → 'No, I'M NOT.'
DIQQAT: 'I amn't' shakli YO'Q.

'I' → AM ('I'm from Spain' ham to'g'ri).
'Spain' = Ispaniya.

'your wife' BIRLIK → IS.
'a wife' = xotin.
'Is ...?' savoliga → 'No, she ISN'T.'

'She' → IS.
'too' = ham (gap oxirida, oldidan vergul).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib namunadagidek savol-javob tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Marilyn Monroe / musician / actress
  Was Marilyn Monroe a musician?
  No, she wasn't. She was an actress.

QOLIP:
  WAS/WERE + ism + [1-ma'lumot]?
  No, he/she/they WASN'T/WEREN'T.
  He/She/They WAS/WERE + [2-ma'lumot].

BIRINCHI ma'lumot — NOTO'G'RI (shuning uchun 'No').
IKKINCHI ma'lumot — TO'G'RI.

DIQQAT — BIRLIK yoki KO'PLIK:
  bitta odam    → Was ... ?  No, he/she wasn't.
  bir necha odam → Were ...? No, they weren't.

DIQQAT — KASB OLDIDAN ARTIKL:
  She was AN actress.   ('a/an' SHART)
  They were inventors.  (ko'plikda artikl YO'Q)

DIQQAT — MILLAT OLDIDAN ARTIKL YO'Q:
  He was FRENCH.     ✓  (sifat)
  He was A French.   ✗ XATO

DIQQAT — 'FROM + MAMLAKAT':
  They were FROM Holland.  (mamlakat nomi)
  They were DUTCH.         (millat sifati)

items.question: Was Marilyn Monroe a musician?
items.answer: No, she wasn't. She was an actress.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Merilin Monro — mashhur amerikalik aktrisa.
'an actress' — 'a' unli tovush oldidan 'an' bo'ladi.
'a musician' = musiqachi.

items.question: Was Napoleon Italian?
items.answer: No, he wasn't. He was French.
items.whyUz:
Napoleon Bonapart — fransuz imperatori.
Bitta erkak → Was ... ? / No, he wasn't.
DIQQAT: millat oldidan ARTIKL YO'Q —
'He was French' ('a French' XATO).

items.question: Were the Wright brothers doctors?
items.answer: No, they weren't. They were inventors.
items.whyUz:
Rayt aka-ukalari — birinchi samolyotni ixtiro qilgan.
'brothers' KO'PLIK → WERE / they weren't.
'an inventor' = ixtirochi;  KO'PLIKDA artikl yo'q.

items.prompt: 4  Cleopatra / the Queen of India / the Queen of Egypt
items.question: Was Cleopatra the Queen of India?
items.answer: No, she wasn't. She was the Queen of Egypt.
items.whyUz:
Kleopatra — Misr malikasi.
Bitta ayol → Was ...? / No, she wasn't.
'the Queen of ...' — 'the' SHART (yagona shaxs).

items.prompt: 5  Van Gogh and Rembrandt / from Austria / Holland
items.question: Were Van Gogh and Rembrandt from Austria?
items.answer: No, they weren't. They were from Holland.
items.whyUz:
Van Gog va Rembrandt — golland rassomlari.
Ikki odam → WERE / they weren't.
DIQQAT: 'FROM' savolda ham, javobda ham qoladi:
'from Austria' → 'from Holland'.
Holland = Gollandiya (Niderlandiya).

items.prompt: 6  Elvis Presley / the king of jazz / the king of rock'n'roll
items.question: Was Elvis Presley the king of jazz?
items.answer: No, he wasn't. He was the king of rock'n'roll.
items.whyUz:
Elvis Presli — 'rok-n-rol qiroli' laqabini olgan.
Bitta erkak → Was ...? / No, he wasn't.
'the king of ...' — 'the' shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table about Bob.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:

                      5 yoshda    Hozir (20 yoshda)
  read and write        ✗              ✓
  ski                   ✗              ✗
  swim                  ✗              ✓
  ride a bicycle        ✗              ✓
  drive a car           ✗              ✓
  make a cake           ✗              ✗

CHAP ustunda HAMMASI ✗ — besh yoshida hech narsa
qila olmasdi. Farq faqat O'NG ustunda.

IKKI XIL GAP:

  ✗ → ✓  (endi qila oladi):
     Bob couldn't ... when he was five years old,
     BUT he CAN ... NOW.

  ✗ → ✗  (hali ham qila olmaydi):
     Bob couldn't ... when he was five years old
     AND he STILL CAN'T ... .

DIQQAT — 'STILL' JOYI:
  he still can't ski.   ✓
  he can't still ski.   ✗

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to ski = chang'i uchmoq
  to make a cake = tort pishirmoq

points.en: read and write — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✓
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
Ikki fe'l birga — 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

points.en: ride a bicycle — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✓
drive a car — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✓
make a cake — 5 years old: ✗, now: ✗
points.noteUz:
✗→✗ → 'and he still can't ...'.
'make a cake' — 'do' emas, MAKE.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and make sentences about Bob, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va Bob haqida namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QOLIP:

  ✗ → ✓ :  Bob couldn't [fe'l] when he was five years old,
           BUT he can [fe'l] now.

  ✗ → ✗ :  Bob couldn't [fe'l] when he was five years old
           AND he still can't [fe'l].

Kitob IKKALA namunani ham bergan (read and write, ski).

items.answer: Bob couldn't read and write when he was five years old, but he can read and write now.
items.whyUz:
✗ → ✓ → 'but he CAN ... NOW'.
Ikkala fe'l ham takrorlanadi: 'read and write'.

items.answer: Bob couldn't ski when he was five years old and he still can't ski.
items.whyUz:
✗ → ✗ → 'AND he STILL CAN'T ...'.
'but' EMAS — qarama-qarshilik yo'q.
'to ski' = chang'i uchmoq.

items.answer: Bob couldn't swim when he was five years old, but he can swim now.
items.whyUz: O'zgarish bor → 'but ... can ... now'.

items.answer: Bob couldn't ride a bicycle when he was five years old, but he can ride a bicycle now.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish bor → 'but ... can ... now'.
'ride a bicycle' — ustiga minasiz → RIDE.

items.answer: Bob couldn't drive a car when he was five years old, but he can drive a car now.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish bor → 'but ... can ... now'.
'drive a car' — ichiga o'tirasiz → DRIVE.

items.answer: Bob couldn't make a cake when he was five years old and he still can't make a cake.
items.whyUz:
O'zgarish YO'Q → 'and he still can't ...'.
'make a cake' = tort pishirmoq ('do a cake' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Now write three sentences about yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi o'zingiz haqingizda uchta gap yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
6a dagi IKKALA qolipdan foydalaning,
faqat 'Bob' o'rniga 'I' va 'he was' o'rniga 'I was'.

QOLIPLAR:

  ✗ → ✓ :  I couldn't [fe'l] when I was five years old,
           but I can [fe'l] now.

  ✗ → ✗ :  I couldn't [fe'l] when I was five years old
           and I still can't [fe'l].

DIQQAT: 'could' va 'can' hamma shaxsda BIR XIL —
ega o'zgarsa ham fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

FOYDALI FE'LLAR:
  read, write, swim, ski, ride a bicycle, drive a car,
  make a cake, cook, paint, play the guitar,
  use a computer, speak English

structure.modelEn: I couldn't swim when I was five years old, but I can swim now.

structure.heading: 2  ✗ → ✓  (yana bitta)
structure.modelEn: I couldn't ride a bicycle when I was five years old, but I can ride a bicycle now.

structure.guideUz:
'and I still can't ...' qolipi bilan.
'still' — 'can't' dan OLDIN.
structure.modelEn: I couldn't ski when I was five years old and I still can't ski.

wordFormation.introUz: 37-bet — 'to be' ning barcha shakllari, kasb va millat nomlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ikki xil ayta olasiz — ma'nosi bir xil.

patterns.formula: WAS/WERE + ism + ma'lumot?  →  No, ... wasn't/weren't.  ... was/were + boshqa ma'lumot.
patterns.exampleEn: Was Marilyn Monroe a musician? — No, she wasn't. She was an actress.
patterns.exampleUz: Merilin Monro musiqachi midi? — Yo'q, emas edi. U aktrisa edi.

patterns.formula: WERE there ANY + ko'plik?  →  No, there weren't, but there ARE some ... today.
patterns.exampleEn: Were there any department stores twenty years ago? — No, there weren't, but there are some great ones today.
patterns.exampleUz: Yigirma yil oldin univermaglar bormidi? — Yo'q, lekin bugun ajoyiblari bor.

patterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when he was five, BUT he CAN + fe'l + NOW.
patterns.exampleEn: Bob couldn't swim when he was five years old, but he can swim now.
patterns.exampleUz: Bob besh yoshida suza olmasdi, lekin hozir suza oladi.

patterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when he was five AND he STILL CAN'T + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Bob couldn't ski when he was five years old and he still can't ski.
patterns.exampleUz: Bob besh yoshida chang'i ucha olmasdi va hali ham ucha olmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm from Spain. She is from Spain, too.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kelib chiqish — DOIMIY fakt → hozirgi zamon.
'too' gap oxirida, oldidan vergul.
